_doc: Look uplift (28 Nov; Yasin: 'go for both 15 and 16'). Hand-placed, one line per thing with its reason, built into the overlay piece x_look_life (tools/city/pilot/pieces/x_look_life.gd); no locked piece changes. JUNCTIONS: the junction piece j_apt is used at 7 crossings, each with the same manhole and the same tyre smudge: here each crossing gets its own wear where its own traffic makes it (a trench patch where a service line was laid across one lane, oil where cars queue behind a stop bar, a pale utility cut, a second utility cover on another arm). The road's frame at a j_apt crossing: roads +-8 m wide each side of the centre lines, the crossing box +-8 m, crosswalks 18-22 m out, stop bars ~24 m out; right-hand traffic (northbound on the east lane, x > centre). y = the road at the crossing (layout row). LOTS: the park lawn at 373,-690 (two tennis courts, one grill on a dirt pad, one bench, a shade sail, two chairs) gets what people who use it bring and need; y = the lawn, 6.15 m (height map; rig ground rays 6.2). The back yards at 100,-40 (piece r_n): measured from r_n's own ground mesh (OUT/groundat.gd), each lot is one flat pad: x <= 85 at 5.81 m, 86-100 at 6.98, 102-114 at 8.16, 116+ at 9.19; houses at z ~-19.5 (backs ~-26), a garage at 97.5,-31; nothing else stands in the yards. Every yard line keeps 1.5 m inside its pad and clear of the house backs and the garage. Decal tiles (kit_lib Decals atlas, wear_lib's notes): 2/3 dark sealed trench patch, 4/5 pale concrete patch, 6/7 oil.
